'''Vartos' moon''' was one of at least two [[Moon/Legends|moons]] which orbited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vartos]].

==Description==
The planet was known to have a thin atmosphere, but did not appear to have any native plants or animals. There was no [[Water/Legends|water]] present on the surface, and surface was mainly flat with occasional rock formations. Both Vartos and a second moon was visible from the ground.

==History==
In [[44 ABY]], reporter [[Madhi Vaandt]] rendezvoused on this moon with a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] under the pseudonym [[Blink]], a member of the [[Freedom Flight]] to find out more about the organization.
